subject: design/feature-draft
statement: Plan a draft-born feature from the latest binding lock and recheck that version against current mainline before drafting, freezing, or projecting.
intent: Keep a reopened draft from replacing the approved version as the planning basis.
rationale: The planning entrypoint chooses the document contract gate when a PRD ledger exists; otherwise it discovers the remote lock, validates its stored text and approval record, and applies the shared readiness predicate to the locked Documents against current mainline.
fit_criterion: A locked feature prints lock/<feature>/vN as its Basis, an open reopened draft keeps that Basis, missing locks and retired external citations refuse, and document-pipeline features still use contract-gate.
